messages:
Alix: Kickoff for Orpheus POC perf benchmark. Sales goal: validate 2.2k sustained qps on /v1/generate (chat-like) with p99 < 200ms for short/medium prompts. They also want burst recovery analysis and a simple hosted vs dedicated cost sketch. Tentative window: Thu 10:00 PT for 90m.

Tom: I can own the load harness and runbook. Need exact prompt mix and streaming ratio. Also confirm auth method — hosted API key, dedicated service account?

Alix: Prompt mix in the packet: 70% short (~30 tokens), 25% medium (~150), 5% long (~400). Streaming ~15% of calls. Auth: API key for hosted; service account for dedicated fallback. Security questionnaire due Wed EOD.

Pieter: Ops note: staging has 4x A10G reserved Thu 08:00-12:00. I can request +2 for the window but need quick capacity approval. Private HSM/BYOK import is ~48h lead time; hosted KMS envelope flow is fine for the hosted run.

Tom: Proposed runs:
- Ramp 0->2.2k qps over 12m, hold 40m steady (steady-state metrics)
- Burst sequence: three 30s spikes to 6.6k qps with 2m recovery between to check queue/backpressure
- Coldstart churn: spawn 8k new sessions over 10m to observe KV-cache priming
I'll use vegeta for open-loop qps and a small Locust streaming profile for SSE semantics.

Tom: vegeta example (will add full bodies in the repo):
```
echo "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" > targets.txt
vegeta attack -rate=2200 -duration=40m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=hdr
```
We'll add X-Run-ID and X-Trace headers and include token-cost headers for alignment.

Alix: Acceptance criteria suggestion: p99(short+med) <=200ms steady, error rate <0.4%, tail recovery <120s after bursts, and sustained throughput within 7% of target for steady window. Capture p50/p90/p99, errors, GPU occupancy, and token cost.

sec-team: Expected security asks: KMS/HSM attestation, BYOK import steps & lead time, audit log retention, SAML/SCIM SSO, and SOC2 report. If Orpheus insists on HSM import for Private, ops lead time ~48h.

Pieter: Capacity request submitted for +2 A10G Thu 07:00-13:00 PT. Pending approval. I'll enable kernel tracing and GPU occupancy metrics for the run.

Tom: I'll push the runbook + scripts to perf/orpheus and post link here when ready. Also prepping a tokens->cost calc: 2.2k qps * avg 60 tokens * 3600s ~= 475M tokens/hour (rough).

Alix: For pricing: show hosted on-demand estimate and a Dedicated commit example that lowers unit cost at scale; include explicit burst-overage math. Also have a slide for graceful degradation strategy (model-shard fallback, prefix caching).

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Orpheus benchmark Thu 10:00 PT. Will post run link and aggregated report after completion.

Tom: :white_check_mark: initial scripts ready, validating prompt distribution locally. Will push shortly.

Pieter: :white_check_mark: capacity request pending accepted, kernel tracing enabled for the window.

sec-team: :white_check_mark: security bullets drafted and uploaded; added expected turnaround for HSM/BYOK.

Alix: Thanks team. We'll use this thread for pre-run checklist, run artifacts, and the final results writeup.
